Talking Stick Casino Transportation: Your Guide to Gaming Night Logistics

Talking Stick Resort is the Valley's premier gaming destination — a huge casino floor, table games, a resort hotel, multiple restaurants, and a busy events calendar. Whether you're planning a casual evening of blackjack or a high-roller weekend, your transportation sets the tone.

The short answer: book by the hour and the vehicle waits for you. A Luxury SUV is $125/hr (4-hour minimum), so a 5-hour casino night is $625 before tax. Groups take the Executive Sprinter at $145/hr or the Party Bus (28 Pax) at $250/hr — about $54 per person for a 6-hour night with 28 aboard.

Casino Transportation FAQ

Q: Can you wait the entire time I'm gaming?
A: Yes. We can wait, or depart and return at an agreed time, whichever you prefer. Either way you're booking the hours.

Q: What if I want to stay later than planned?
A: Extensions are charged hourly at your vehicle's rate. Just communicate with your driver.

Q: Do you coordinate with other Valley casinos?
A: Absolutely. We serve Desert Diamond, Wild Horse Pass, Fort McDowell, and others.

Q: Can I drink in the vehicle?
A: Yes, if you're 21 or older. Arizona's open-container law (A.R.S. § 4-251) exempts passengers in a vehicle for hire such as a party bus or limousine, so alcohol is legal on board. It's BYOB, nobody under 21 drinks, and the driver never does — read the full explainer.

Q: What if I have a big win and want to celebrate?
A: We love winners. Bring the bottle and we'll have the cooler ready.

Q: How do you handle losing streaks?
A: With discretion. We're professionals who've seen it all.

Q: What's your cancellation policy?
A: Cancellation terms depend on your date and booking; read the cancellation policy before you book. One free date change at 72+ hours. See our policies page.
